scan.description: Whole-field visual scan: retract antenna, deploy and turn roof radar, retract dish, restore antenna. Empty hands remain lowered. Forward work pose independent of heading; no sensing logic or game state mutation.

decisionThinking.description: Visual status only. Eye sides are viewer-relative. Thinking repeats until the caller supplies a result or another action. Result is provided externally; do not infer or randomly generate a condition outcome.

decisionTrue.description: Visual status only. Eye sides are viewer-relative. Thinking repeats until the caller supplies a result or another action. Result is provided externally; do not infer or randomly generate a condition outcome.

decisionFalse.description: Visual status only. Eye sides are viewer-relative. Thinking repeats until the caller supplies a result or another action. Result is provided externally; do not infer or randomly generate a condition outcome.

decisionLights.note: Colors are generation targets. Actual eye pixels are baked into the robot-decision-v01.png frames. No extra light overlay or glow filter is needed. These clips are empty-hand front work poses; preserve cargo and use separate carry variants if the game needs loaded decision poses.

soilVariants.composition: Draw layers in ascending z onto one soil canvas, below the existing plant layer. destinationRect uses canvas pixels; sourceRect uses atlas pixels. Never mutate the base atlas.
soilVariants.selection: Persist the chosen variant ID per tile; do not choose a new variant during animation or redraw.

areaScanWave.layerPlacement: Above soil and plants, below robot and cargo; preserve existing rendering.layerOrder.
areaScanWave.sampling: sourceRect in atlas pixels. Center each frame at anchor within fieldBounds; sizeRatio is width/height relative to fieldBounds. frameIndexByStep and opacityByStep follow the owning animation clip playback steps, not sprite indices. Clip to union of actual field cell rectangles for irregular fields. Null frame is hidden.
areaScanWave.reducedMotion: Respect the shared paused/reduced-motion playback setting; do not run an independent effect timer.

placement.description: Bottom-left of the bubble canvas anchored to these normalized robot-canvas coordinates. Height follows canvas aspect. Draw above robot and cargo; do not change existing rendering.layerOrder.

thoughtBubbles.note: Bubble animation has its own elapsed-time cursor within the shared render clock; do not use the eye/shell frame index for dot phases. Source art includes the cream cloud, thought puffs and pictogram. Result selection comes from external game logic. Scan, carry, harvest, movement and idle have no bubble mapping.

coordinateRules.file: Relative to assets/; existing paths unchanged.
coordinateRules.textRect: [x,y,width,height] relative to sourceRect top-left, in unscaled source pixels. Apply the same scale/translation as the sign image.
coordinateRules.groundAnchor: [x,y] relative to sourceRect top-left in source pixels; stake tip insertion reference.
coordinateRules.repeat: unitSize and step are SOURCE pixel dimensions. Repeat sourceRect without its surrounding atlas padding; use recommendedDisplaySize for logical display tile dimensions. Never repeat the entire PNG for greenhouse or floor.
coordinateRules.recommendedDisplaySize: [width,height] logical CSS/game pixels at 1x. Icons use contain; signs preserve source aspect when fitting this box.
coordinateRules.alpha: RGBA originals; transparent exterior and tile grout. Do not flatten over a background when exporting.

repeat.verification: Visually continuous mid-mullion join; generated pixel colors retain minor sub-level variation, not a byte-identical periodic texture.
All four source-unit edge alpha values are zero. Repeat over a chosen grout/floor color; retain transparent grout gaps.

mainScreenAssets.note: Static art only; no new animation, growth, sensing, economic, token-cost or currency logic. Existing manifest fields including root version remain unchanged.

valleyFarm.name: 山谷農田・輕微俯角

grass.note: Transparent sparse tufts over baseColor, all four outer edges alpha0.

soilFront.sourceSpace: Full image pixels; sample only the solid bands, excluding margins and stray generation specks.

environment.rectSpace: Normalized [x,y,width,height] of viewport. Background layers scale independently of grid; never squash upright sprites.

projection.interactionNote: Invert only the ground projection for cell picking and placement. Exclude the decorative frontDepth from cell hit bounds; keep all existing game grid/collision rules. Claude owns game integration.

terrain.frontRule: Draw a front face only if the neighbor cell at [x+frontNeighbor[0],y+frontNeighbor[1]] is absent from the combined occupied-cell set. Test across plot boundaries too. Draw below y+tileHeight, with width=tileWidth and height=frontDepth. No interior dividing soil wall.
terrain.seamRule: Adjacent top faces share the exact grid boundary; no per-cell gap, rotation, skew or corner rounding. Corners use straight cut ends of the front strip.

uprightSprites.rule: Compress only soil/ground surfaces. Keep plants, robots, held produce, thought bubbles and signs upright at their original aspect ratio.

depthOrder.rule: Sort all upright sprites globally by their projected ground anchor, across plot boundaries. Draw increasing groundY; nearer plants may occlude robots farther back. Cargo/thought bubbles belong to the same robot draw group. Front soil walls are terrain, not upright sprites.

preview.note: Static composition preview; no game mechanics or independent animation timer.
preview.signAnchorRule: Use [minimum field cell x, maximum field cell y] + signOffset, then project to screen; signs stand beside the lower-left outer edge.

valleyFarm.note: Additive data; previous manifest fields, asset paths and alignment shape unchanged. Game projection, picking, dragging, movement rendering and final occlusion integration remain Claude responsibilities.
